description: A trigger burst sequencer: seven stages run one after another, each lasting a whole number of clock beats and packing a whole number of evenly spaced triggers into them

params.text: Takes one off that stage's beat count on each press, down to none, at which the stage stays silent while keeping its length
Adds one to that stage's beat count on each press, up to 99, which is how many triggers are packed into the stage
Takes one off that stage's cycle count on each press, down to none, at which the stage is skipped altogether
Adds one to that stage's cycle count on each press, up to 99, which is how many clock beats the stage lasts
Steps that pattern position through don, ka and off on each press, which is where the trigger at that position is sent
Jumps the sequence to that stage on the next clock beat
Sets the length of the pattern, 1 to 10 steps, rounded up
Attenuverts the pattern length CV before it is added to the pattern knob
Sets whether the sequence runs: OFF holds every output low, ON runs it round and round, and ONE-SHOT stops it at the end of the seventh stage
Returns the sequence to the first stage and the pattern to its first step on each press

inputs.text: Each rise advances the sequence by one beat; it also reads the three chaining levels another CV funk clock sends, at 10.42V, 10.69V and 10.86V
A rise returns the sequence to the first stage and the pattern to its first step
Changes the pattern length, added to the pattern knob through its attenuverter, the total rounded up and clamped to 1 to 10

outputs.text: A 1ms 10V trigger every time the pattern step reached is set to don
A 1ms 10V trigger every time the pattern step reached is set to ka
A 1ms 10V trigger at the end of the whole sequence, or at the end of each stage on the menu setting

notes: nothing runs until a clock is patched and the play switch is away from OFF; the stage lengths are measured in clock beats, so the module has no tempo of its own
a stage with no cycles is skipped entirely, and a stage with cycles but no beats holds its length in silence; the first stage cannot be skipped, its cycle count being held at one or more
menu: END outputs pulse at — chooses whether the END output fires once at the end of the whole sequence or at the end of every stage, the choice shown beside the item as sequence end or stage end
Pattern resets — chooses whether the pattern returns to its first step at the end of every stage or only on a reset, shown beside the item as at stage end or only upon reset

inputs.2:
bipolar · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 1 to 10V.
